response.sql:
WITH matched_snapshots AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, sf.shortintrt, sf.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
), transaction_avgs AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist,
         AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt,
         AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
), mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS baseline_shortintrt
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT ta.transreg AS transaction_reference,
       ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       ta.avg_shortintrt AS average_short_interest_days_to_cover,
       ta.avg_optvolrt AS average_option_volume_ratio,
       ta.avg_shortintrt / mb.baseline_shortintrt AS short_interest_to_mix_baseline_ratio
FROM transaction_avgs AS ta
JOIN mix_baselines AS mb
  ON ta.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
  OR (ta.ordertypedist IS NULL AND mb.ordertypedist IS NULL)
ORDER BY short_interest_to_mix_baseline_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each matched sentiment row is one snapshot; SQLite AVG ignores NULL values. A NULL order type is treated as its own mix, and division by a zero or NULL baseline yields a missing ratio, sorted last.
